subject: lavPredict requires extra cases to predict scores of just one case

messages.author: 0a0e220f5d46e88c
messages.subject: lavPredict requires extra cases to predict scores of just one case
parts:
I have built and fitted a large Thurstonian-IRT model in Lavaan, and want to predict the factor scores of new cases.

However, lavPredict would not predict only for one case and needs to be padded with about 30 cases to work. This slows down my predictions. Is this an issue of lavPredict others have had before? 

I think it may be cause because a distribution of cases needs to be provided for the estimator (expected a posteriori; EAP) to work.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavPredict requires extra cases to predict scores of just one case
parts:
I am afraid this will not work (yet). In the categorical case, the
'newdata' is processed just like the original data, and lavPredict()
requires that the characteristics of the 'newdata' are the same as the
original data. This implies (among other things) that the number of
(response) categories is the same. There is no way to figure this out
with a single case.

For the continuous case, we found a way around it, but for the
categorical case, this is not done yet. Feel free to open an issue about
this on github.

Yves.
